messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Wow, {01 00 00 0a 00}it's been a while since
I've worn something that
makes me THIS pretty!
{07 14 00}I just love being me,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0d 00}Vau, {01 00 00 0a 00}ammu pole olnud, et
kannaksin midagi, mis teeb
mu NII ilusaks!
{07 14 00}Mulle meeldib olla mina,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
